A Lass (Japanese: ミニスカート Miniskirt; in Generation I, also known as ミニスカ Miniski) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation I games. They are depicted as average young girls in clothing resembling school uniforms. Lasses appear to be the female counterparts of s, and they grow up to be . 

They use a variety of Pokémon but tend to use cuter and/or common Pokémon such as , , , etc. In the Battle Maison of Generation VI, they specialize in - and Pokémon. In the in Generation VIII, they specialize in - and Pokémon.

In Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, Lasses will award three s along with prize money upon being defeated, except Gym Trainers and Master Trainers.

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
A Lass briefly appeared in the theme song Aim to Be a Pokémon Master and its English counterpart Pokémon Theme. She wears an orange blouse with a red ribbon and a green miniskirt, and runs under her.

The character of Giselle, who appeared in The School of Hard Knocks, seems to be loosely based on the Lass design.

In Getting Down to The Ire!, a Lass observed the Manalo Conference alongside a and a .

===Pokémon Origins===
A Lass briefly appeared in File 1: Red, being one of the Trainers residing at the Pewter Gym. Later, in File 3: Giovanni, was briefly seen battling another Lass with his .

====History====
===== =====
A Lass in a Gold, Silver, & Crystal design with her made a cameo appearance in Just a Spearow Carrier, waiting in line for the Indigo League.

===== =====
A Lass was seen walking to the Indigo Plateau in Oh, It's Ho-Oh!.

===== =====
In Out-Odding Oddish, accidentally bumped into a Lass with her while racing to get to the Pokéathlon Dome. Later in the same chapter, a Lass and her were seen entering the Pokéathlon Dome.

In Weavile Wobbles But It Won't Fall Down, a Lass was shown checking out the Southwest stall at the Safari Zone Gate.

===== =====
A Lass and her briefly appeared in Deprogramming Porygon-Z, where they were waiting in line along with the other Trainers for the opening of the . Later in the same chapter, another Lass was seen encouraging her friend to go with her to the .

===== =====
A Lass along with her was one of the Trainers that was listening to Ghetsis's speech in An Odd Speech.

In Dream a Little Dream, a Lass was briefly seen amongst the Trainers about to enter .

===== =====
A Lass appeared in Kangaskhan...Kangascan't, walking together with a female in Santalune City.

==== ====
A Lass was one of Leon's onlookers at Hammerlocke in Stealth!! Infiltrate the Energy Plant.
